title: Corporate and Commercial
overview: We advise businesses on starting, running and growing. Our lawyers help owners and managers put the right structure, contracts and governance in place, and keep the business within the law as it changes. We act for start-ups, family businesses, established companies and foreign investors entering Nigeria.

whatWeDo.name: Company formation and structure
whatWeDo.text: Choosing the right type of company, registering it with the Corporate Affairs Commission, and setting up its shares and ownership.

whatWeDo.name: Corporate governance
whatWeDo.text: Board and shareholder matters, company secretarial support, annual filings and statutory records.

whatWeDo.name: Shareholder and partnership agreements
whatWeDo.text: Setting out who owns what, who decides, and what happens when a partner leaves.

whatWeDo.name: Commercial contracts
whatWeDo.text: Supply, distribution, agency, franchise, services and licensing agreements.

whatWeDo.name: Joint ventures and alliances
whatWeDo.text: Structuring and documenting how two or more parties work together.

whatWeDo.name: Foreign investment
whatWeDo.text: Helping overseas businesses, and Nigerians abroad, set up and operate in Nigeria.

whoFor: Owners, directors and investors in businesses of every size.
helpful: a short note of what you want to achieve and by when

title: Mergers and Acquisitions
overview: We advise buyers, sellers and investors on transactions involving Nigerian businesses. We manage the legal work from the first discussion to completion, and explain each step as it happens.

whatWeDo.name: Share and asset purchases
whatWeDo.text: Advising on the best structure and preparing the transaction documents.

whatWeDo.name: Legal due diligence
whatWeDo.text: Reviewing the business being bought or invested in, and reporting the risks in plain language.

whatWeDo.name: Investments and funding rounds
whatWeDo.text: Acting for investors and for companies raising money, including start-ups.

whatWeDo.name: Mergers and reorganisations
whatWeDo.text: Combining businesses, and restructuring groups of companies.

whatWeDo.name: Regulatory approvals
whatWeDo.text: Identifying and obtaining the approvals a transaction needs from regulators.

whatWeDo.name: Completion and afterwards
whatWeDo.text: Closing the deal and dealing with matters that follow.

whoFor: Buyers, sellers, investors and the companies they deal with.
helpful: A summary of the proposed deal

title: Banking and Finance
overview: We advise lenders and borrowers on credit, security and the rules that govern financial services. We explain the terms, the risks and the steps to completion, so that each party knows where it stands.

whatWeDo.name: Loans and credit facilities
whatWeDo.text: Preparing and negotiating loan agreements for banks, companies and individuals.

whatWeDo.name: Security and guarantees
whatWeDo.text: Taking, giving and enforcing security over property, shares and other assets.

whatWeDo.name: Project and asset finance
whatWeDo.text: Financing for infrastructure, equipment, vessels and similar assets.

whatWeDo.name: Trade and receivables finance
whatWeDo.text: Funding based on goods, invoices and trade flows.

whatWeDo.name: Cross-border lending
whatWeDo.text: Transactions with lenders and borrowers in other countries.

whatWeDo.name: Financial regulation
whatWeDo.text: Advising on licences and the rules of the Central Bank of Nigeria and other regulators.

whoFor: Banks, other lenders, companies and individuals who borrow.
helpful: The offer letter or term sheet
details of assets offered as security

title: Capital Markets
overview: We advise on raising money from investors and on dealing in securities. We help companies, issuers and investors understand the rules and meet them.

whatWeDo.name: Equity offerings
whatWeDo.text: Public offers, private placements and rights issues.

whatWeDo.name: Debt securities
whatWeDo.text: Bonds, notes and commercial paper.

whatWeDo.name: Listings and disclosure
whatWeDo.text: Listing on an exchange and meeting continuing disclosure duties.

whatWeDo.name: Funds and investment schemes
whatWeDo.text: Setting up and advising on collective investment schemes.

whatWeDo.name: Regulatory filings
whatWeDo.text: Applications and filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission and the exchange.

whatWeDo.name: Governance for listed companies
whatWeDo.text: Board duties, reporting and shareholder meetings.

whoFor: Issuers, investors, fund managers and listed companies.

title: Dispute Resolution
overview: We act for clients in courts, arbitration and mediation. We begin by explaining the options, the likely steps and the costs, so that you can decide whether to go to court or to settle.

whatWeDo.name: Civil and commercial litigation
whatWeDo.text: Representing clients in the courts.

whatWeDo.name: Arbitration
whatWeDo.text: Acting in domestic and international arbitration.

whatWeDo.name: Mediation and negotiation
whatWeDo.text: Reaching a settlement without a trial where that serves the client.

whatWeDo.name: Debt recovery
whatWeDo.text: Demand letters, claims and recovery steps.

whatWeDo.name: Enforcing judgments and awards
whatWeDo.text: Turning a decision into payment or action.

whatWeDo.name: Appeals
whatWeDo.text: Advising on and bringing appeals.

whoFor: Individuals, families, companies and public bodies in dispute.
helpful: any court papers you have received, with deadlines marked

title: Employment and Labour

whatWeDo.name: Contracts, handbooks and policies
whatWeDo.text: Preparing and reviewing employment documents.

whatWeDo.name: Hiring and moving staff

title: Real Estate and Property
overview: We advise on land and buildings for owners, buyers, tenants, landlords, lenders and developers. We check the title carefully before money changes hands, and explain each step of the process.

whatWeDo.name: Buying and selling
whatWeDo.text: Acting for buyers and sellers of homes, land and commercial property.

whatWeDo.name: Title investigation
whatWeDo.text: Checking ownership, records and any claims against the property.

whatWeDo.name: Consents and registration
whatWeDo.text: Governor's consent, registration and perfecting title.

whatWeDo.name: Leases and tenancies
whatWeDo.text: Preparing, negotiating and ending leases for homes and commercial space.

whatWeDo.name: Development and construction
whatWeDo.text: Development agreements, land assembly, planning approvals and building contracts.

whatWeDo.name: Property finance
whatWeDo.text: Loans secured on land and buildings.

whatWeDo.name: Landlord and tenant disputes
whatWeDo.text: Recovering possession, rent and resolving disagreements.

whoFor: Home buyers, landlords, tenants, developers, investors and lenders.
helpful: Title documents (such as the certificate of occupancy, deed of assignment and survey plan)

whatWeDo.name: Tax planning
whatWeDo.text: Structuring investments, transactions and businesses with tax in mind.

whatWeDo.name: Company and personal tax
whatWeDo.text: Income tax, capital gains, VAT and withholding tax.

whatWeDo.name: Transaction tax
whatWeDo.text: Tax advice on mergers, acquisitions, property and financing.

whatWeDo.name: Audits and assessments
whatWeDo.text: Responding to notices, audits and assessments.

whatWeDo.name: Tax disputes
whatWeDo.text: Objections, appeals and proceedings before the tax tribunals and courts.

whatWeDo.name: Cross-border tax
whatWeDo.text: Double taxation, transfer pricing and tax for Nigerians abroad.

whatWeDo.name: Incentives and exemptions
whatWeDo.text: Applying for and keeping available tax reliefs.

helpful: the agreements or structure chart that the question relates to
